run_llama_finetuning: run a LLaMA model fine-tuning job with FSDP, PEFT, and quantization support via fire CLI
run_finetuning_with_peft: run fine-tuning of a LLaMA model using PEFT adapters with configurable rank and dropout
run_finetuning_with_quantization: run 4bit or 8bit quantized fine-tuning of a LLaMA model using BitsAndBytes config
run_finetuning_with_fsdp: run distributed fine-tuning of a LLaMA model using Fully Sharded Data Parallel across GPUs
run_finetuning_with_wandb: run fine-tuning of a LLaMA model with Weights and Biases experiment tracking enabled
